title: papaver suaveolens
intro: Papaver suaveolens, commonly known as the Sweet Shining Poppy, is a perennial plant species within the Papaver genus. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions. The plant's health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which can help to relieve pain and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Papaver suaveolens include its ability to act as a muscle relaxant and to exhibit sedative effects, while its bioactive constituents include alkaloids and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
